newsitem.title: USA: BoC's Freedman says bank keeps close eye on forex.
newsitem.headline: BoC's Freedman says bank keeps close eye on forex.

text.p: Bank of Canada Deputy Governor Charles Freedman said the bank keeps close tabs on exchange rate movements, but declined to comment on reports the central bank had intervened to support the flagging Canadian dollar on Friday.

"In nervous markets, you see effects on exchange rates and on interest rates, and obviously, we keep a very close eye on movements in the markets," said Freedman at a conference at the Jerome Levy Economics Institute.

Ask by Reuters if the Canadian dollar's current decline to two-year lows raised concerns for the central bank, Freedman declined to comment specifically, but reiterated that bank officials monitor published foreign exchange quotes closely.
